toolu_013DkBUEVbu7cgwUjRR48cch.prompt:
用Confluence搜索工具查找Lisa写的一个页面，内容关于：
- 主题：切换到supply chain catalog后，non-food库存在pantry中如何管理
- 作者：Lisa

请使用Confluence搜索功能，尝试以下搜索词：
1. "Lisa supply chain catalog non-food pantry"
2. "supply chain catalog non-food inventory pantry" 
3. 如果上面的不成功，试试 "supply chain catalog pantry 库存"

找到页面后，提供：
- 页面标题
- 页面链接（URL）
- 页面所在的Confluence space
- 页面ID
- 内容摘要（如果能获取的话）

    "content": {
      "value": "| **Version** | Date | Updated By | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| V1.0 |  | Daisy | First version |\n| V1.1 |  | Daisy | Set Min/ Max |\n| V1.2 |  | Daisy | display the non-food items that have min/max |\n| V1.3 |  | Daisy | * Bulk Upload Min/ Mx in pantry web * Add on-hand inventory column in manage item page |\n| V1.4 |  | Daisy | * add item name in bulk upload template * Auto-clear Min/ Max |\n| V1.5 |  | Daisy | * add the validation: if the item’s vendor source is not “dish/millington“, the min/max must be 0 |\n\nnone\n\n[Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/kL5nZhpN1NYZH19eZZM7ul/Pantry-Web?node-id=15551-5917&t=VkUvhPaCMhP1yJjm-1)\n---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nSummary\n-------\n\nAdd a new page “Manage Items on Inventory and Non-Food pages. The user must be able to set the item min/max for ordering on the page, support for both components and non-foods.\n\nRequirement Analysis\n--------------------\n\n* On the Inventory page, I must be able to see “Manage“ button\n\n  ![image-20240624-053453.png](https://wonder.atlassian.net/wiki/rest/api/content/3297739617/child/attachment/att3297936315/download)\n* On the Non-Food page, I must be able to see “Manage“ button\n\n  ![image-20240624-054440.png](https://wonder.atlassian.net/wiki/rest/api/content/3297739617/child/attachment/att3297641515/download)\n\n### Manage in Non-Foods\n\n#### **MD supports: Set HDR\\_item flag in CookBook**\n\nIntroduce a new property on item in Cookbook called `HDR Item` in logistic card. This is a boolean property. If true, then the item is expected to be at the HDR.\n\n1. when an non-food created, default to `no` , means the item is not a HDR item--> it won’t be listed in pantry to count inventory and place order.\n\n   1. --> it won’t be able to listed in all HDRs and `Used at this HDR in pantry = no`\n2. when it is included to current or scheduled Menu Item/ HDR recipe BOM in cookbook, automatically set it `yes(from BOM)`, **and** if it is used in the active menu item in the specific HDR, means the item is a that HDR’s Item\n\n   1. --> it gonna be listed in that HDR and `Used at this HDR in pantry = yes`\n3. use can manually set the `hdr_item` flag from `no` to `Y(others)` or yes(from BOM) to `Y(others)`, means the item is a hdr\\_item for all HDRs\n\n   1. Note: Y(others) should not be overwritten by system anyway\n   2. --> it gonna be listed in all HDR and `Used at this HDR in pantry = yes`\n4. In some case, if a non-food item is not used in a specific HDR, then HDR manager can update the `Used at this HDR` flag based on a specific HDR in pantry web, if an item `used at this hdr = false` , it won’t be sent to busboy to place order.\n\nabout the idea that we separated `yes(other)` and `yes(from BOM)` in cookbook,\n\n1. an item’s hdr\\_item=yes(from BOM) in cookbook, it doesn’t mean the item is used in the HDR’s active menu item.\n\n   1. for example: [9000031](https://cookbook.remarkablefoods.net/ItemV2/detail/basic/9000031) in cookbook it used in the “active” menu item [Lobster Roll, Bankside (8001697)](https://cookbook.remarkablefoods.net/ItemV2/detail/basic/8001697), but that menu item does not sale for all HDR.\n   2. ---> busboy do not actually need to place order for the item and it won’t be need in HDR physically.\n   3. ---> in pantry we should not display those items like this even it looks used in active cookbook menu item.\n2. the other concern is that, for the non-food item which is included in menu item BOM, if we don’t automatically set it to Yes\n\n   1. Manage in cookbook may need to set up this HDR\\_Item flag one-by one manually, which may be more labor cost to set up items.\n   2. and small concern: if they are missing to set an non-food that using in HDR active menu item, then in cookbook, the non-food’s hdr\\_item=no. but it will still display in pantry web, which may cause some confused for user.\n\n##### New way to handle HDR Item in cookbook(pending dev)\n\n~~Introduce two properties~~ “`Guest Packaging: yes or no`\" ~~and~~\n\nRe-define `hdr_item` field to `yes or no`:\n\n1. `Guest Packaging: yes or no`: ~~cannot be edited, only calculate by system~~\n\n   1. ~~Guest packaging = yes, once it’s used in the active/ schedule BOM~~\n2. `hdr_item`: yes or no, default to “No“, manually set by user\n\n   1. if HDR\\_Item=yes, it will show up in the pantry non-food page for all HDR\n   2. if HDR\\_Item=No, it won’t show up in the pantry for all HDR\n   3. Note, if an non-food item is an guest packaging item(means it should be ordered according to menu item usages). it should be set as `hdr_item=no` in Cookbook , and then the guesting packaging non-food will be calculated by pantry for each HDR.\n3. need migration: HDR\\_Item: Yes(others)-> yes, else, no\n\nIn pantry, display the non-food items:\n\n1. Used in HDR active Menu Item\n2. HDR\\_Item=yes\n\n#### Pantry Manage Item in non-food\n\nWhen user enters the manage item page, list all non-foods that from the conditions with the following columns\n\n##### **Data**\n\nList all items with following conditions in the manager items page:\n\n* **Part 1: Active non-food items:**\n\n  + Non-food items that are used in the first level BOM or customization of **active** menu items/HDR Recipe for the current HDR\n\n    - if the menu item’s fist level BOM Item is a HDR recipe Item, we should grab the non-food item of the HDR recipe’s BOM as well\n  + Active Non-Food Items must have the mapping restaurant(s).\n  + `used at this HDR` **default to Yes and can not be turn off by user**\n* **Part 2: Yes (Others) Non-Food**\n\n  + All non-food item’s`HDR_Item = Yes(others)`\n\n    - the item status should be active( if an item is marked as “Dormant“ in Cookbook, we won’t display it)\n  + `used at this HDR` default to Yes and it could be turn off by user\n* **Part 3: All items with min/ max(Min/Max is not bull)**\n\n  + `used at this HDR` default to Yes and it could be turn off by user\n* **Part 4: Scheduled Non-Food Items:**\n\n  + Grab the non-food items from latest demand forecast qty and whose service\\_date >=today and <= today+30 days and object item = Non-Food\n  + `used at this HDR` default to Yes and and can not be turn off by user\n  + unlike the active items, the scheduled guest package items will NOT have the mapping restaurants because WHISK does not have restaurant data.\n\nThe reason we need scheduled non-food item here\n\nCurrently, in Pantry Web, we only list the ‘Guest packaging’ (HDR-item = ‘Yes, from BOM’) non-food items for those they are in the active menu and in active BOM.\n\nSuppose we are introducing a new non-food item in next week and for up-coming HDR, we need to set the min/max for it several days before the item’s restaurant being active.\n\nTo support setting min/ max and place order from upcoming restaurant and HDR，we should display scheduled non-food in the web, so that user can configure item in web\n\nNote, this is only for non-food item, food items do not have this problem because food items' orders are based on TSL, not Pantry’s min/max setting.\n\n##### **Common columns**\n\n1. TYPE: {Non-Food object\\_sub\\_type}\n2. RESTAURANTS: {Restaurant}\n\n   1. the active restaurants that using this item\n   2. if no, display “-“\n3. ITEM: {ITEM\\_NUMBER}\n4. ITEM\\_NAME: {ITEM\\_NAME}\n5. IMAGE Icon: {Item\\_image}\n6. OH: {On-Hand inventory}, can not be updated\n\n##### **Sorting**\n\n1. by default, we will sort items by Item Type ascending, then Restaurant ascending (then null), then Item Name ascending\n2. User can update the sort by clicking the columns “Type“, “Restaurant“, “Item“, name , ~~“Min“, “Max“~~\n\n#### **Set “Used at this HDR” Flag**\n\n* For all items that listed in the manage item page, `used at this HDR` default to Yes\n\n  + if the item is used in the active Menu items for current HDR, it can not turn off by user.\n\n    - Turn the toggle on in UI, ,and display the “Lock“ icon on the right to indicate it cannot be updated\n  + else, user can manual turn it of, if an item’s `used at this HDR= no` , we won’t place order for that item and display it in the non-food main page unless it have inventory left.\n\n    ![image-20240624-070933.png](https://wonder.atlassian.net/wiki/rest/api/content/3297739617/child/attachment/att3297773103/download)\n* Submit behavior\n\n  + if user update the data in the manage items, then click “submit“ we should save the updated data and go back to the non-food view.\n\n    - if user don’t change any data, we should gray the “Submit“ button\n  + If User click “Cancel“, back to non-food page\n\n#### Set min/max in Manage Items\n\n1. Users must be able to set and edit min/max for non-food in “Manage Items“ Page as long as they have access to “Set min/max“\n\n   1. Must be a number >=0\n   2. Validation:\n\n      1. Max must be > Min, if not, display the error: “You must increase max above min.”\n      2. Min must be < Max, if not display the error: “You must decrease min below max”\n      3. Unit: Quantity in the least pickable UOM( same logic like quantity).\n   3. After user input value, then need to click “Submit“ button. then save the value.![image-20240129-071419.png](https://wonder.atlassian.net/wiki/rest/api/content/3297739617/child/attachment/att3297936204/download)\n   1. Then go back to non-food page, I must be able to to see the MIN/MAX in non-food page.\n\n      1. If 0<Quantity < Min, we should display the row in yellow\n2. After user set the min/ max in the Pantry based on the HDR level, we should provide the data to busboy at the midnight. (for one non-food item in the multiple HDR, Min/ MAX value could be different.)\n\n   1. Quantity in each\n   2. When an item on-hand qty < min value, busboy will automatically create order for item, Request qty=Max-on\\_hand( the is the busboy logic).\n3. Add the “No Min/Max“ toggle in Non-Food view\n\n   1. default to off, display the all non-food item\n   2. user can turn it on, we should show those items for which we don't have either a min or a max or both set.\n\n      ![image-20240130-160400.png](https://wonder.atlassian.net/wiki/rest/api/content/3297739617/child/attachment/att3297936210/download)\n\n#### Bulk upload in Pantry Web for min/max setting\n\n[Designs](https://www.figma.com/design/kL5nZhpN1NYZH19eZZM7ul/Pantry-Web?node-id=15551-447&t=qUEGE6G44qkVDgdZ-0)\n\nOn the **Inventory and Non-Food pages** of Pantry Web, upon a user clicking Manage Items (rename to just Manage), add two buttons to the left of the cancel/submit buttons:\n\n* Download Template\n* Bulk Upload\n\n![image-20240624-081126.png](https://wonder.atlassian.net/wiki/rest/api/content/3297739617/child/attachment/att3297937037/download)\n\n##### Download Template\n\n1. Upon clicking “Download Template”, download a file with the following columns (type CSV):\n\n   1. Item Number\n   2. Item Name\n   3. Unit of Measure: {same as UOM in the web}, like Pk (500 EA), CS (360 EA) etc\n   4. Min\n\n      * Quantity in UOM\n   5. Max\n\n      * Quantity in UOM\n2. File Name： MIN & MAX-{HDR}-{Date}, example: MIN & MAX\\_Upper West Side\\_7\\_3\n3. In the file, I should be able to see Pre-fill in this file with item number and UOM for all items listed on that HDR’s non-food or inventory pages, sorted by item number.\n\n   1. If I click download on the non-food page, then show all non-food items that are enabled for my HDR (omit those that are hidden on the manage items page).\n   2. If I click download on the inventory page, only show all food components.\n\n##### Bulk Upload\n\n1. Upon clicking Bulk Upload, prompt the user for a file to upload. Accepted formats are **Excel and CSV.**\n\n   1. when user update a file, then we should bulk upload the min/ max for current HDR\n   2. If there are no values for an item in the file, do not set the values to null for the item.\n   3. to make sure the flatted ea qty in db is integral, if inputed value of CS \\* pack size has decimal, we will automatically remove the decimal as UI behavior\n2. After upload, popup the update reason window to display the upload details:\n\n   1. Green: Show the count of items successfully uploaded\n\n      1. Message: xx items successfully uploaded\n   2. Red: the count that could not be uploaded with corresponding reason\n\n      1. Title: Massage：The following items could not be set:\n\n         1. If Min or Max is missing or Min > Max, or min/ max is not a number\n\n            * {Item\\_number} {Item name}: min greater than max\n            * {Item\\_number} {Item name}: no max value set\n            * {Item\\_number} {Item name}: no min value set\n         2. if a user includes items that are not of the corresponding type for the upload (i.e. if I upload to the non-food page some food items, then show the errors for items or the nonfood item is not on the HDR list or the item’s `used_at_this_hdr= false`), we should display the error message\n\n            1. {item number} {item name} min/max cannot be set in this file\n         3. If there is duplicate item number in the file, and one more min/max is set and they are different\n\n            1. {item number} {item name} has multiple rows in the file\n         4. if a user updates the UOM for an item to be a value that does not match the system\n\n            1. show this error: {item number} {item name} has the wrong UOM\n         5. If an item that `vendor_source ≠ Dish/ Millington` and min and max is not 0 in the uploaded file, then display the error message:\n\n            1. {item number} {item name}: Min/Max must be 0\n\n               ![image-20240624-083355.png](https://wonder.atlassian.net/wiki/rest/api/content/3297739617/child/attachment/att3298427664/download)\n\n**New UX to upload min/max**\n\nWhen user upload the s\n\n#### Auto-clear Min/ Max\n\nwhen an non-food item is not used in HDR, we should automatically clear the min/ max\n\n1. if user updates the cookbook's `HDR_Item` flag from Yes(others) -> No and it is no in 30+ days menu item, then we will automatically clear the item’s min/ max for all HDRs\n2. ~~Daily Job to clear Min/Max if an item is not used in the 30+ days menu items and its~~ `HDR_flag is not Yes(others)` ~~for a HDR, then we should automatically clear the item’s min/ max for that HDR~~\n3. if user turn off the “used\\_at\\_this\\_hdr“ in pantry manage item page, we should automatically clear the item’s min/ max for that HDR.\n\n   1. when upload to set min/max, we should prevent user set the min/ max for that item as well\n\n|  | **Case** | **Cookbook** | **Pantry** |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | if a non-food item‘s HDR Item updated from Yes(others)-> No | Cookbook will make sure the item has not active and 60+ days' menu BOM usage | Clear min/max for all HDRs |\n| 2 | a non-food item is yes (from BOM), if user remove the non-food item’s all active and schedule menu items usage.  ~~means the non-food item is not yes(others) and it is not active today and doesn’t include in 30+days items.~~ | In this case, cookbook will update the non-food from Yes(from BOM)-> No | Clear min/max for all HDRs |\n| 3 | If a non-food item is marked as dormant | Cookbook make sure the item has not any active and scheduled menu item usage | Clear min/max for all HDRs |\n| 4 | If user turn off the “used\\_at\\_this\\_hdr“ in pantry manage item page | -- | Clear min/max in that HDRs |",

    "content": {
      "value": "Table of Contents:\n\nnone\n\nBeverage/Non-food inventory from Shawnee\n----------------------------------------\n\nWonder is transitioning beverage and some non-food inventory from the Millington warehouse to Shawnee, a third-party (3PL) warehouse that uses the Extensiv WMS.\n\nThis document describes the order flow from Shawnee to HDRs.\n\n---\n\n### Cookbook and SCC Data\n\nExample:   \n`<https://cookbook.remarkablefoods.net/ItemV2/detail/basic/8005538`> – [**Water, Sparkling, Open Water, Non-Alcoholic Beverage**](https://cookbook.remarkablefoods.net/ItemV2/detail/basic/8005538)\n\ntextwide7608005538\nL 4000727 \\* 1 ea\n\n* 4000727 represents 1 bottle of water.\n* 4100884 = 4000727 \\* 24. 4100884 represents 1 case/pack of 24 bottles of water.\n* In the supply chain catalog, 4100884 maps to vendor SKUs.\n\n  + Seems Shawnee directly use 88\\* ([8807667](https://cookbook.remarkablefoods.net/ItemV2/detail/basic/8807667) representing 24 bottles) as vendor SKU#.\n\n---\n\n### Min/Max Settings for Beverages\n\n* For beverages, we configure minimum and maximum inventory levels to trigger purchasing from vendors.\n\n  + min/max will be moved to SCC.\n\n---\n\n### HDR Order Flow\n\n2100484166922148324608631Untitled Diagram-1770970247568.drawio11https://wonder.atlassian.net/wikiUntitled Diagram-1770970247568.drawio0710.9999999999995311\n\n* Ladle generates HDR replenishment orders on Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday based on the min/max inventory settings and current on-hand quantities.\n* Ladle sends these orders to Shawnee via Sporklift.\n* After Shawnee receives an order, it sends a confirmation message to Sporklift, which is then forwarded to POMS.\n* POMS sends the order information to Pantry. Pantry create orders with status = “Open”.\n* Physical shipment & receiving at HDR\n\n  + Shawnee physically ships goods to HDRs (no shipped event back to Wonder).\n  + After the truck arrives:\n\n    - HDR Ops uses the Pantry app to receive against the Open order.\n    - Blind receiving is not allowed for Shawnee orders.\n    - Upon successful receiving, Pantry increases the on-hand quantity.\n\n---\n\n### Other Processes\n\n**Auto-decrement**\n\n* When an order starts cooking, the on-hand beverage inventory is auto-decremented.\n\n**Cycle count**\n\n* See the configuration in Pantry. We run system-directed cycle counts for 7 beverage items every Monday and Thursday at 2:00 PM.\n* Note: for beverages, one “ea” represents one pack. We support partials (such as 5/24) to represent individual bottles (i.e., less than a full pack).\n\nHDR Non-food orders from Ed Don\n-------------------------------\n\nSome non-food items  `(smallwares, disposables, first aid, etc.),` are ordered from Ed Don.\n\n* In Pantry web - non food page (<https://pantry.remarkablefoods.net/non-food?hdr_id=74e8d0b9-3eda-4510-8ee2-95314a833b27> ), for each non-food item, we set the supplier: Ed Don, Extreme, or DISH/Millington.\n* Do not set min/max in Pantry for non-food.\n\nFor HDR non-food orders from Ed Don, the flow is:\n\n* **Ordering**\n\n  + HDR GMs place **non-food orders directly in the Ed Don portal**\n  + All HDR Ed Don orders route to a central approver (Supply Chain / Proc team) before being released.\n  + Some flows specify Regional Directors reviewing/approving orders placed by site managers.\n* **Data transit**:\n\n  + Ed Don sends order data to Wonder\n  + Wonder systems ingest POs to BigQuery\n  + Pantry sync POs from BigQuery\n* **Receiving**\n\n  + See also: Ed Don Receiving\n  + GM opens **Pantry Mobile → Receive → Search PO** using the PO number from the Ed Don packing slip.\n  + Pantry shows **the full PO**, not filtered by delivery date.\n  + GM must confirm **each line item** (no “Confirm All” blind receiving).\n  + Quantities default from ordered qty but can be adjusted down if not fully received.\n  + Once received, quantities are auto-consumed for non-food (consistent with current non-food behavior).\n\nHDR Non-food orders from Extreme\n--------------------------------\n\nExtreme Digital (Wonder Print Shop) is used for **printed materials** for HDRs.\n\nThe process is similar to Ed Don, as:\n\n* Someone places order on Extreme Portal\n* Kyle/infra will pull **PO data from Extreme** into our warehouse (similar to Ed Don) with a new a flag/field to identify that an order is **Extreme vs Ed Don**.\n* Pantry sync POs from BigQuery\n* Receiving are also similar.",
      "format": "markdown"
    }
  }
}"}
